mapper.sql: content_id AS content_id, title, content, author, source, dynasty, poetry_category, author_id, tag_names, topic_ids, hot_score, quality_score, freshness_score, updated_time
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM content_feature_snapshot WHERE content_id = #{contentId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO content_feature_snapshot (content_id, title, content, author, source, dynasty, poetry_category, author_id, tag_names, topic_ids, hot_score, quality_score, freshness_score, updated_time) VALUES (#{contentId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{author}, #{source}, #{dynasty}, #{poetryCategory}, #{authorId}, #{tagNames}, #{topicIds}, #{hotScore}, #{qualityScore}, #{freshnessScore}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE title = VALUES(title), content = VALUES(content), author = VALUES(author), source = VALUES(source), dynasty = VALUES(dynasty), poetry_category = VALUES(poetry_category), author_id = VALUES(author_id), tag_names = VALUES(tag_names), topic_ids = VALUES(topic_ids), hot_score = VALUES(hot_score), quality_score = VALUES(quality_score), freshness_score = VALUES(freshness_score), updated_time = NOW()
